ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; approximately 98% of pixels across the visible ventral surface occupy the low-intensity (black/dark grey) range with minimal high-intensity white variance.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform solid dark pigmentation across both lobes; absence of high-contrast geometric mottling or focal pigmentation spots on the primary surface area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; interior angle estimated at approximately 45-55 degrees at the central vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; jagged pixel-step transitions with vertical amplitudes ranging from 3 to 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave sweep from the medial notch leading to upturned distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, high-density white/tan pixel clusters located exclusively at the lateral distal tips of both lobes, corresponding to calcareous barnacle colonies.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, low-contrast light-grey vertical and diagonal linear disruptions visible on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral encrustation of barnacle colonies at the extreme tips of the lobes, creating a textured, high-contrast white border against the dark fluke body.
